source.author: verg
source.text: nos, tua progenies, caeli quibus adnuis arcem, navibus infandum!
source.text_original: nos, tua progenies, caeli quibus adnuis arcem, / navibus (infandum!)
source.text_english: We, your offspring, to whom you grant the citadel of heaven, with ships—unspeakable!

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hanc mihi militiam, veterum quae pulchrior actis, adnue daque animum.
reuse.text_original: 'hanc mihi militiam, veterum quae pulchrior actis, / adnue daque animum.
reuse.text_english: Grant me this service, more splendid than the deeds of old, and give me courage.
